name: WindowAttention

qkv_bias.description: whether QKV projection has bias; default True

reference:
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

def run(x, dim=None, window_size=7, num_heads=8, qkv_bias=True, qk_scale=None):
    torch.manual_seed(42)
    B, N, C = x.shape
    if dim is None:
        dim = C
    if isinstance(window_size, int):
        Wh, Ww = window_size, window_size
    else:
        Wh, Ww = window_size
    head_dim = C // num_heads

    rel_table = torch.zeros((2 * Wh - 1) * (2 * Ww - 1), num_heads, device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)

    coords_h = torch.arange(Wh, device=x.device)
    coords_w = torch.arange(Ww, device=x.device)
    coords = torch.stack(torch.meshgrid([coords_h, coords_w], indexing='ij'))
    coords_flatten = coords.flatten(1)
    relative_coords = coords_flatten[:, :, None] - coords_flatten[:, None, :]
    relative_coords = relative_coords.permute(1, 2, 0).contiguous()
    relative_coords[:, :, 0] += Wh - 1
    relative_coords[:, :, 1] += Ww - 1
    relative_coords[:, :, 0] *= 2 * Ww - 1
    rel_index = relative_coords.sum(-1)

    qkv = nn.Linear(C, 3 * C, bias=qkv_bias).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    proj = nn.Linear(C, C).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)

    qkv_out = qkv(x).reshape(B, N, 3, num_heads, head_dim).permute(2, 0, 3, 1, 4)
    q, k, v = qkv_out[0], qkv_out[1], qkv_out[2]
    scale = qk_scale or (head_dim ** -0.5)
    q = q * scale
    attn = q @ k.transpose(-2, -1)

    rel_bias = rel_table[rel_index.view(-1)].view(N, N, -1).permute(2, 0, 1).contiguous()
    attn = attn + rel_bias.unsqueeze(0)

    attn = F.softmax(attn, dim=-1)
    out = (attn @ v).transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, N, C)
    out = proj(out)
    return out
description: Window-based multi-head self attention (Swin-style) with relative position bias.
